name: Research Communication For Electrical Engineers
description: Introduction to research communication; Principle of effective communication: Clarity, conciseness, coherence, accuracy; Written communication skill: Technical reports, research articles and project proposal writing (Structure of a research paper/report, research problem, outcomes, timeline/scheduling); Visual communication: Effective figures and tables, data representation; Oral Communication: presentation preparation and delivery skill, poster presentation; speaking to large audience (technical and non-technical)
